requirement.en: During your opponent's turn, when your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.

effect.en: Change up to 3 face-up Level 7 Pyro Type monsters on your field to face-down Defense Position. Then, change them to face-up Attack Position. Then, you can change the battle position of 1 monster on your opponent's field.
